def top_n_frequent_words(words, n):
    raise NotImplementedError('top_n_frequent_words not implemented')
description: Write top_n_frequent_words(words, n) returning the n most frequent words (list of str), ties broken alphabetically ascending.
golden_solution:
def top_n_frequent_words(words, n):
    from collections import Counter
    c = Counter(words)
    ordered = sorted(c.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
    return [w for w, _ in ordered[:n]]
